title: Hotel Branding & Visual Identity
description: A complete hotel branding project bringing together a consistent visual identity across the logo, brand board, restaurant menu, business cards, door hanger and room key cards.
objective: Develop a cohesive and polished visual identity for a five-star hotel, applying the same brand style across guest-facing print materials and hotel collateral.
steps: Created the hotel logo and mini brand board to establish the visual direction, colours and typography.
Designed the restaurant menu cover, interior menu pages and back page.
Applied the hotel identity to both sides of the business card.
Designed the door hanger and front and back of the room key card.
Refined the layouts and visual consistency across the different branded items.
results: A coordinated hotel branding kit that presents a consistent identity across core brand assets, restaurant materials and guest amenities.

challenges.problem: Keeping a consistent look across several different formats and sizes.
challenges.solution: Used a shared colour palette, typography and visual direction to connect the menu, stationery and guest materials into one identity.
